note: Reported value is the drafted corridor CENTRELINE in that sheet's own working-raster pixels (work/sheets/1912w/u<N>.jpg, the same pixels the green rulers label), following the pair_33_34 convention. sheet 14 faces N 77.0 / S 318.5 at its Ave F (east) edge; sheet 49 north face 3619.6 at its Ave F (west) edge + 120.5 px half-width (sheet 49's 26th St drafted 241 px). overlap is Ave F (Church) only; sheet 49 south face falls off the page bottom. The drafted 80' corridor measures 239-245 px on these plates; centreline sigma ~3 px, plus ~2 px where a half-width had to be supplied. Each plate's frontage tilts 8-13 px across the sheet, so the reading window was matched to the two plates' shared avenue. Detection's candidates were all block-interior or siding lines (e.g. sheet 11 cand1 y=3558 falls inside the Pattern & Casting warehouse, 200 px north of the corridor centre) and none were used.
